item.title: About the Directory
item.description:
The Dubai Calligrapher Directory is a curated, verified reference directory of UAE-based Arabic calligraphers. Our mission is to provide a reliable bridge between the public and the masters of Arabic calligraphy residing in the United Arab Emirates.

Why This Directory Exists

item.title: Disclaimer
item.description:
The Dubai Calligrapher Directory is a reference tool provided for informational purposes only.

No Brokerage

We list public contact information for calligraphers based in the UAE. We do not act as brokers, agents, or intermediaries in any transactions or agreements between you and the artists listed.

Accuracy of Information

While we strive to keep our directory accurate and up-to-date, we cannot guarantee the current validity of external links or the availability of the artists.

item.title: Privacy Policy
item.description:
Your privacy is important to us. This policy explains how we handle any information you provide through our website.

Data Collection

We do not use cookies for tracking or collect any personal data from visitors browsing the directory.

Forms

When you use our contact or suggestion forms, the data is processed by Formspree. We only collect the information you explicitly provide (name, email, message) to respond to your inquiries or process your suggestions.
